title: Amazingly Juicy Italian Daikon Pinsa
description: A grassy and indulgent Italian dish featuring daikon, with a unique spherified twist, perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the water and sodium alginate.
Add the sliced daikon to the bowl and let it sit for 30 minutes to allow the daikon to absorb the alginate mixture.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the daikon mixture into a bath of cold water to spherify.
Remove the spherified daikon from the water and set it aside on a paper towel-lined plate.
Roll out the pinsa crust mix to a thickness of 1/4 inch and place it on a baking sheet.
Drizzle the olive oil over the crust and sprinkle with italian seasoning and salt.
Arrange the halved cherry tomatoes and chopped fresh basil over the crust.
Top the crust with the shredded mozzarella cheese and spherified daikon.
Bake the pinsa in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
